description: Ferran Martinez is the spectre bound to the altar at Sokal Keep, sustaining its supernatural defenses. His spectral touch drains two experience levels in combat; he can be freed by parley and the codeword LUX. His original template carries no physical equipment or wealth.
description_sources: Original game MON4CHA.DAX:19 and matching MONnITM inventory
GameDocs/Cluebook.pdf, Sokal Keeps map location 8: spectre, level-draining touch, and parley resolution.
name: FERRAN MARTINEZ
